originalCensus: Per version: five ATTDEF and four ATTRIB. AC1021 has single280; AC1024/27 classic records have dual280; AC1032 has four classic dual ATTDEFs and three classic dual ATTRIBs plus one embedded dual of each. No AcDbXrecord or column-bearing embedded MTEXT in the 36 originals.

packet.operation: Qualify original classic dual280 source roles for ATTDEF and ATTRIB on AC1024, AC1027, AC1032, keeping AC1021 single-lock behavior.
packet.expected: Version zero immediately following the owning subclass is ReservedDefault; the later lock boolean is Attribute, with original span/owner/membership and modeled replay bound. ATTRIB has no mandatory prompt and belongs to an INSERT/SEQEND compound.
packet.safety: After accepting a dual profile, explicitly refuse a later Embedded Object transition; checking only !nested at the second280 is insufficient because embedded MTEXT may follow. Reject nonzero prefix, reversed/misplaced/third fields and cross-scope shadows. Preserve existing single280 behavior. Preserve exact parent/child/footer identities, ownership and membership independently of callback counts.
packet.validation: Add local-from-scratch same-profile positives across selected versions, ASCII/binary and both lock values, full ordered roles and genuine INSERT/ATTRIB/SEQEND plus ENTITIES/BLOCKS membership; retain distinct malformed controls and verify canonical single-lock writer output/ordinary readback. Run one affected normal/ASan union after source freeze.
packet.scope: Classic means the existing admitted rest-of-record grammar; additional field placements remain unqualified.

limits: Current probes establish the original byte sequence, rejected source audit and ordinary library model/INSERT/footer only. They do not prove an independent source producer, native semantics, output preservation or complete document closure.
The observed attVersion=0 is the current parser model default, not an independently decoded version field.
AC1032 embedded dual profiles, AcDbXrecord, extra alignment/columns and other secondary bodies remain unqualified.
Input drawings remain scratch-only; committed tests use eligible existing repository fixtures or authored local recipes.
